psi0 = np.array([1, 0], dtype=complex)

H = (1/np.sqrt(2)) * np.array(
  [[1, 1], [1, -1]], dtype=complex)

psi1 = H @ psi0
probs = np.abs(psi1) ** 2

# psi1  = [0.7071+0j 0.7071+0j]
# probs = [0.5 0.5]
caption: H @ psi0 is one vectorized matrix-vector product — no Python loop, a clean 50/50 split.
